تِحْلِىءٌ and ↓ تِحْلِئَةٌ The hair on the surface of a hide, and its dirt, and blackness: (K:) or what is pared off from the back of a hide. (Lh, TA in art. بشر.) ―
-b2- Also What the knife spoils, of a hide, in the process of shaving it. (S, K.) ―
-b3- رَجُلٌ تِحْلِئَةٌ (tropical:) A heavy, or dull, or troublesome, man, (TA,) who sticks to another [like dirt], and vexes him. (K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
